arStrings.szText: World of Warcraft: Relics of Azeroth

Collect {icon:Event_Currency_Cocoa, 1.8} Relics of Azeroth Currency and use them to claim World of Warcraft: Relics of Azeroth themed cosmetics.
{icon:bullet}Elite and Champion monsters have a chance to drop {icon:Event_Currency_Cocoa, 1.8} Relics of Azeroth Currency upon being slain. 
{icon:bullet}Claim all rewards to unlock the {icon:ReliquaryDetails_BonusIcon, 2.0} Bonus reward.
